title: For China, Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Is a Mixed Blessing
summary_full: Beijing may welcome the return of the leading U.S. advocate for A.I. chip sales to China. But the saga could reinforce a Chinese push for self-reliance, analysts say.
